<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral and judicial oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court is reviewing over 37 lakh pending electoral roll appeals in West Bengal and has ordered an inspection of the NTA office regarding the Nandan Nilekani panel report.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Diplomatic and committee appointments:</strong> The Lok Sabha Speaker has nominated two Rajya Sabha members to the Joint Parliamentary Committee on the FCRA Bill, while the Nepal cabinet has recommended a new ambassador to India.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
